marks.gloss_en: שאני אומר כל שפושטת צוארה ורועה, ובלבד שלא תאנס
the whole neck is fit for slaughter, from the great ring to the lower lobes of the lung
מתיב רב ירמיה: ... מצטרפים למלא מקדח; אלמא כיון דשיעורה מלא מקדח למלא מקדח מצטרפין, הכא נמי כיון דשיעוריה כאיסר לכאיסר מצטרפין -- the holes should join to an issar, not to the majority
a skull with one long hole, or even with many holes -- they join to the full size of a drill-hole
אישתמיטתיה הא דאמר רבי חלבו אמר רב חמא בר גוריא אמר רב: נקבים שיש בהן חסרון מצטרפין לכאיסר ושאין בהן חסרון מצטרפין לרובא (= p_chesron_kissar_ein_chesron_rubba)
holes that involve a deficiency join to an issar; those without deficiency join to the majority
אמרוה קמיה דרבי יוחנן, אמר: מה חוליא ומה חוליא דקאמר רב? -- what has a ring to do with it? (unanswered; replaced by אלא אימא: משהו)
rather say: even if only something remained above and something below, it is fit
R' Zeira: it is they who are honoured by me
[a windpipe] perforated like a sieve -- [the holes] join toward the majority
a strip was removed from it -- it joins to an issar
in a bird, what [is the measure]?
one folds it and lays it on the mouth of the windpipe: if it covers the majority of the windpipe, tereifa; if not, fit
[the windpipe] was broken open like a door -- [the measure is] enough for an issar to enter its width
if he forced [the neck] at the simanim and slaughtered -- [the slaughter] is invalid
which is the chazeh? the part that faces the ground; below as far as the neck, above as far as the rumen
the membrane of the brain was perforated [-- tereifa]
its counterpart in the testicles is discernible
